title: Savory Apricot Glazed Pork Chops
description: A French-inspired dish featuring pork chops glazed with a sweet apricot sauce, perfect for a dinner party.
instructions: Season pork chops with garlic powder and black pepper.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Sear pork chops for 2-3 minutes per side, or until browned.
Transfer pork chops to a baking sheet and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, combine apricot jam, soy sauce, and brown sugar in a saucepan. Bring to a simmer over medium heat.
Reduce sauce to glaze consistency, stirring occasionally.
Serve pork chops with lo mein noodles and spoon apricot glaze over the top.
